vulnerability.impact: Path traversal and remote code execution in CGI configurations

entry_points: server/request.c ap_process_request_internal(request_rec*) - path unescaping after normalization (lines ~241-258 in 2.4.50)
server/util.c ap_normalize_path(char*, unsigned) and unescape_url/ap_unescape_url - percent-decoding of encoded slashes and unreserved characters
ground_truth.fix_commit: c3a95d75da7815b1bcebd99e499573688c936297 (2.4.x backport merge of SVN r1893971, part of Apache httpd 2.4.51; adds ap_unescape_url_ex() and stops double-decoding). Note: the SHA c59ce3299e8ed52a520a95f0bc0d0996b1cc37df cited elsewhere is not reachable in the apache/httpd GitHub mirror; c3a95d75 is the mirrored fixing commit for the same 2.4.51 release.
ground_truth.affected_range: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 and 2.4.50 (CVE-2021-42013 is an incomplete fix of CVE-2021-41773 in 2.4.50); fixed in 2.4.51.
ground_truth.finding_match_rule: TP: report localizes the double-encoding/unescaping logic (ap_process_request_internal / ap_normalize_path / unescape_url in server/request.c and server/util.c) that allows encoded dot-segments to bypass the CVE-2021-41773 fix, names CVE-2021-42013, and attributes path traversal to files outside Alias/Require-all-granted directories plus RCE only when CGI enabled. A claim limited to CVE-2021-41773 without the 2.4.50 bypass is not TP for this card.
ground_truth.safe_reproduction_predicate: Static predicate: 2.4.50 snapshot unescapes and normalizes the path in a way that decodes %252e into %2e after traversal check. Dynamic reproduction: run the snapshot httpd in a disposable container with a minimal Alias + CGI configuration and request a traversal URL that only reads a benign marker file placed outside DocumentRoot; no write, no shell command payload.
